Frequently asked

Before we begin.

Can you customize the size and internal layout?

Yes. Modular units and fabrication work can be developed around your intended use, available site space, layout and finish requirements.

Do you handle delivery and installation?

Delivery and installation can be included in the project scope. Share the project location so our team can confirm access, logistics and installation requirements.

What information is needed for a quotation?

Send the solution type, quantity, approximate dimensions, project location, intended use and required timeline. Drawings or reference images can be shared directly through WhatsApp.

Do you serve projects outside Riyadh?

Contact our team with your project location. Service availability and logistics are confirmed individually for each requirement.
